device: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit

gpu_clock_locked_hz.source: results/20261022_E0_platform_MAXN/clock_probe.csv: median of 200 devfreq cur_freq samples (20 Hz, 10 s bf16 4096^3 GEMM loop, jetson_clocks applied); min 1575000000 = max 1575000000
gpu_clock_locked_hz.caveat: devfreq reports the requested clock; the over-current throttle (gpu_power_limit) is not visible in it
gpu_clock_locked_hz.cross_check: ncu SM frequency 1.5735 GHz (results/20261022_E0_toolcheck); tegrastats GR3D_FREQ 1574 MHz

ncu_cross_check_note: max_gpu_frequency_khz (and clock_rate) read 1,048,576 = 2^20, a placeholder on this integrated GPU, not a clock; global_memory_bus_width and memory clock read 0 (unified LPDDR5X, no discrete frame buffer). The clock comes from devfreq.

memory.type: LPDDR5X (spec, not readable on the device)
memory.bus_width_bits: 256 (spec; ncu device__attribute_global_memory_bus_width reads 0 on this integrated GPU)
memory.spec_source: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor product page, as quoted in docs/00_context.md (a hint, not verified here); measured bandwidth: T003

spec_tflops: n/a: deferred to T003, which records NVIDIA's published per-precision figures with their sources

gpu_power_limit.oc_throttle: soctherm oc2 and oc3 have throt_en=1; oc3 fires when VDD_GPU reaches the warning limit
gpu_power_limit.definition: burst = first 0.5 s slice (no OC event); sustained = median of the slices from the first OC event onward
gpu_power_limit.source: results/20261022_E0_platform_MAXN/raw/power_limits.txt (ina3221 curr1_max / curr1_crit), results/20261022_E0_platform_MAXN/idle_power.csv (bus voltage), the two OC probe CSVs

sources.gpu_arch: results/20261022_E0_toolcheck/raw/cublaslt_sm_strings.txt and results/20261022_E0_addenda/raw/cublaslt_list_text_sm_strings.txt (cuobjdump: sm_110 / sm_110a cubins in the cuBLASLt torch loads); torch capability (11, 0) agrees
